scope: Independent adversarial review of selected partner frequency rational content and large fixed factors. Existing author controls read and hash-bound, not rerun.
findings: The rational content is the maximal rational factor with no prime below S. The ideal count at each c has length O(T/c^2), and a subunit upper bound below one is empty. The total actual eligible support is O(T/B). Grouping the actual j-th powers gives the squared mass O((DH)^eps (T/B)^j) by ordered multiplicities and a divisor bound, without assuming the residual support sparse on each sixth-power fibre.

At fixed S-part and sixth-power part, the exact raw multiplier is the conjugate character of that whole fixed factor. No disjointness of q and its sixth-free residual is imposed. At each Q dyad the two norm comparisons before the j-th root are respectively T^(j/2) Q^(1/2) B^(-j/2) and T^(j/2)Q^-2, with the physical sieve factor evaluated at the shortened max(1,T^j/Q^6).

The crossover is x=b/5. Delta is convex and nondecreasing, so its composition with j(t-6x)_+ is convex. On the first affine branch the maximum is at x=0 or x=b/5; beyond the crossover the generic branch and sieve term both decrease. This proves the two sparse moment endpoints with all bounded scales.

The three divisor lines follow from the original normalized pairing. For e <= 1/8 the exact omitted term is -e/6. For e in [1/8,1/4] the fixed j=12 cutoff and equality expression is convex and has endpoint value -9/32 including the -3/8 Poisson scale. For e >= 1/4 the longer-second and shorter-fourth cutoff factor gives -11/32 with equality decay discarded.

At t0=9/20+3b/5 with b<=9/28 the shortened Delta drop pays the b/10 branch difference. If it crosses below the diagonal threshold, the unshortened gain is at least Delta(t0)/2 and exceeds b/10 by 1/80. All four stated rational threshold pairs check. At t=3/4,b=3/8 the first line indeed leaves 1/16.

Actual q(J) is divisible by the product of input q factors by floor superadditivity, while S-parts multiply exactly. The q tail of the square-root mass is Q0^(-2j), and the fixed S-Euler product gives the S0^(-j/2+j eps) bound. The residual sieve keeps shortened length, and the exact q and S factors keep all phases and zeros. At T=R the sixth-part exponents are -1/8,-3/32, giving the three stated budgets. The S-part threshold reduces the exponents to the previous t=9/20 budgets.

Above T=R, Delta is Lipschitz with constant one, so the exponent of the unweighted frequency comparison grows by at most log_D(T/R), while the original radial profile retains fourth power decay. This absorbs the polynomial divisor subpowers with small internal epsilon. No finite-frequency truncation is silently substituted.

The extra selector depends only on the actual frequency and fixed original labels. The live 14Li caps, true primitive conductor, re-expressed direct term and selected original middle equality subtraction are preserved. The latter only uses divisor-bounded coefficients and therefore retains the separate R/E budget. No full-frequency primal collapse is applied to selected modes.
limitation: Only the actual stated selected frequency subsets are estimated. Main-scale small rational, small sixth-power and small S-parts and coupled defect selectors remain open.
